description: Add a touch of style to your bathrooms with the iDesign Forma Adjustable Length Shower Curtain Tension Rods. This set of two expandable extra large shower curtain rods can be adjusted from 78 to 108 inches to fit a variety of shower sizes, including longer lengths such as 72, 84, and 96 inches. The coated, non-slip feet and patented Constant Tension technology provide secure placement to prevent slipping and protect bathroom walls from damage. Simply twist and lock the tension rod securely into position - no drills, tools, or hardware required! Designed with versatility in mind, they can also be used between windows, door frames, closets, or as room dividers. The corrosion and rust resistant brushed stainless steel construction provides long-lasting durability and matches a variety of bathroom and home decor styles. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
